conditions: Tenet Exec never comes from a Sister of Parvos. Do not start a Sister, farm Murmurs, or buy Requiem mods for this weapon.
A shop-bought Tenet weapon enforces its MR requirement; the Sister-weapon MR bypass does not apply.

groups.activity: inspect the current Tenet Exec roll
conditions: Ergo sells exactly one Exec per 4-day rotation for 40 Holokeys. Its displayed element and 25-60% bonus reroll each rotation.
No Perrin Sequence standing is required; use Browse Merchandise in any Relay.
The weapon is untradeable and has no Market-platinum or converted-adversary route.
bonuses: Bank 40-80 keys first, then buy on percentage rather than buying the first low roll you see.
Elemental Vice can change the bonus element at rank 40; percentage is the lasting decision.

disclosures.title: a low roll costs calendar time
disclosures.body: Only one Exec can be bought per rotation. A 25% first copy takes nine fusions and ten purchases to reach 60%: 400 keys and at least 40 days. Waiting for 52.8% or better turns that into two purchases and one 4-day wait.

groups.activity: buy Tenet Exec on a good roll
conditions: The purchase is instant and does not use the Foundry, but it needs a free weapon slot.
Impact is a strong natural choice for the slam shockwaves, though it can be changed later with Elemental Vice.
Fusion sets the result to min(1.1 × the higher bonus, 60%), rounded down to one decimal; any result at 58% or higher becomes 60%.
Hold copies until a strong roll appears. Fusing two low rolls before a 53% copy arrives wastes a purchase.
Start the fusion from the invested Exec and use the other as donor. Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapters, lenses, and Elemental Vice on the donor are destroyed.
bonuses: At rank 40 (five Forma), Elemental Vice unlocks Valence Override to swap the element freely; it never changes the percentage.
